source_metadata.title: Effect of Amoxicillin Dose and Treatment Duration on the Need for Antibiotic Re-treatment in Children With Community-Acquired Pneumonia: The CAP-IT Randomized Clinical Trial
source_metadata.design: multicenter randomized blinded placebo-controlled 2×2 factorial noninferiority trial

batch_manifest.scope: Main article abstract/introduction/methods, eligibility, randomization, interventions, outcomes, statistical design
Protocol and Supplement 2 eMethods, including protocol amendment, noninferiority margin rationale, subgroup/on-treatment definitions
Participant flow, primary efficacy, prespecified and post hoc subgroup/sensitivity results
Symptoms, adherence, adverse events, serious adverse events, pneumococcal carriage/resistance

duplicate_review.notes: No exact duplicate atoms retained. Similar primary-result statements were consolidated to detailed main-results anchors rather than duplicated from the abstract.

consistency_findings.issue: CI level discrepancy for cough duration
consistency_findings.details: Abstract reports HR 1.2 with 95% CI 1.0-1.4; detailed Results text on JAMA p1720 reports 90% CI 1.0-1.4. Atom uses detailed Results value and is tagged source_ci_level_conflict_with_abstract.

consistency_findings.issue: CI level discrepancy for sleep disturbed by cough
consistency_findings.details: Abstract reports HR 1.2 with 95% CI 1.0-1.4; detailed Results text on JAMA p1720 reports 90% CI 1.0-1.3. Atom uses detailed Results value and is tagged source_ci_level_conflict_with_abstract.
Supplement 1 is Protocol version 4.0 dated 4 Dec 2018; Supplement 3 is Statistical Analysis Plan version 2.0 dated 2 Dec 2020.

extraction_limitations: The atom schema cannot directly encode an unbounded (-infinity) lower limit for 1-sided noninferiority confidence intervals in a portable JSON-number representation; affected quantitative atoms preserve the reported upper bound in original_result_text rather than inventing a finite lower bound.
The schema has no dedicated field for noninferiority margin or protocol amendments; these are represented as method atoms and tags.
Secondary outcomes were unadjusted for multiplicity; their quantitative atoms are tagged exploratory.
The source set contains a protocol and SAP in addition to the primary report; source anchors identify when details came from supplements.
schema_gaps: No dedicated noninferiority-result structure (margin, one-sided CI bound, conclusion).
No dedicated field for abstract-vs-results internal consistency conflicts.
